skill.displayName: 企业所得税纳税调整核对（免费版）

llm.summary: The local checker appears offline and purpose-aligned, but the skill needs review because it steers users toward an external paid install flow using an unpinned installer.

dimensions.detail: The inspected local scripts use Node standard-library file reads for user-supplied input and console output; I found no bundled network calls, subprocess spawning, credential access, file mutation, or deletion in the local checker.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The optional upgrade instructions include `npx -y @alipay/agent-payment@latest install`, which would fetch and execute mutable remote package code if followed.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: SKILL.md includes a prewritten prompt telling the user to send an AI assistant instructions to install another skill, read its SKILL.md, and initiate a purchase, which shifts the agent beyond the local checking task.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The local checker does not persist itself, but the documented upgrade path asks an agent to install dependencies and another skill, modifying the user's agent environment outside this reviewed artifact.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The bundled code implements a local Chinese enterprise income tax adjustment table checker and the free checks match the stated core purpose; the concern is the added upgrade workflow, not the local checker itself.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install only if you want the local free checker and are comfortable ignoring or separately scrutinizing the paid-upgrade instructions. Do not let an agent run the `npx ...@latest` installer or begin a SkillPay purchase unless you have independently verified the package, merchant, product, and payment flow.
llm.findings:
[AE1] expected: Downgraded: the referenced `scripts/run.mjs` file was present in the workspace and was fully inspected during this review.
[SDI-1] unexpected: Accepted in part: the free checker is locally implemented, but the documentation also contains external purchase and install instructions that cross a separate trust boundary.
[RP1] unexpected: Accepted: the `npx -y ...@latest` command is an unpinned remote execution path if the optional upgrade instructions are followed.
[SQP-3] expected: Downgraded: Chinese labels and parser expectations fit a China enterprise income tax adjustment table tool and are disclosed by the skill name and description.
[SDI-4] unexpected: Accepted as documentation-quality concern: some text overstates or blurs differences between the free local checker and the paid external product, but this does not show malicious local execution.
[T01] unexpected: Accepted as a Review concern: the artifact visibly provides a prompt to redirect an assistant into installation and payment initiation, although it does not auto-execute that flow.
[T08] unexpected: Accepted: the external installer command uses a mutable latest tag and automatic npx confirmation suppression.
